spans.s: अह ind. A particle implying- (1) commendation; (2) rejecting; (3) deviation from custom.
आह (I) ind. An interjection- (1) of reproof; (2) of severity; (3) of command.

आह (II) ???. An irregular verbal form of the third person singular present tense of a defective root meaning “to say, to speak,” (traced by native grammarians to ब्रू). There are altogether five forms of the root existing in the language, viz., आत्थ, आहतुः, आह, आहतुः and आहुः.
अहंयु a. Proud, haughty, अहंयुनाथ क्षितिपः शुभंयूरूचे वचः Bt.i.20.
अहत n. A new garment. (ईषद्धौतं नवं श्वेतं सदशं यन्न धारितम् । अहतं तद्विजानीयात्पावनं सर्वकर्मसु.)
आहत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Beaten, struck (as a drum); 2. struck (generally); 3. trodden, पादाहतं यद् (रजः) उत्थाय मूर्धानमधिरोहति Sis.ii.46; 4. rolled; 5. multiplied (in math.).
आहत (II) m. A drum.
आहत (III) n. 1. A new garment; 2. a nonsensical speech, an assertion of impossibility (for instance, वन्ध्यासुतोऽहम्).
आहत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Beaten, struck (as a drum); 2. struck (generally); 3. trodden, पादाहतं यद् (रजः) उत्थाय मूर्धानमधिरोहति Sis.ii.46; 4. rolled; 5. multiplied (in math.).

अहन् n. (nom. अहः, -हनी or -ह्नी, -हानि) 1. Day-time, सव्यापारामहनि न तथा पीडयेन्मद्वियोगः Megh.ii.25; 2. a day, i.e. day and night together, (as in अघाहेषु निवृत्तेषु). (As the last member of a compound, अहन् generally appears in the form of अह m. or n. and sometimes अह्न m. As the first member of a compound, अहस् and अहर् are the usual forms).
अहस्कर m. the sun.
अहरागम m. the approach of day.
अहर्गण m. 1. a series of sacrificial days; 2. a month.
अहर्दिवम् ind. day by day, daily.
अहर्निश n. day and night.
अहःपति m. the sun.
अहःपति m. the sun.
अहःपति m. the sun.
अहःपति m. the sun.
अहःपति m. the sun.
अहर्मुख n. commencement of the day, morning.
अहःशेष n. evening.
अहम् (nom. sing. of the first personal pronoun.)
अहम्-अग्रिका f. a contest for superiority.
अहम्-अहमिका f. 1. assertion of superiority, egotism; 2. military vaunting.
अहम्-कार m. 1. self-love considered as spiritual ignorance (in Vedānta phil.), Bg.ii.71, vii.4; 2. egotism, pride, haughtiness; 3. one of the 25 elements of creation (in Sāṅkhya phil.)
अहम्-कृति f. 1. self-love considered as spiritual ignorance (in Vedānta phil.), Bg.ii.71, vii.4; 2. egotism, pride, haughtiness; 3. one of the 25 elements of creation (in Sāṅkhya phil.)
अहम्-पूर्विका, -प्रथमिका f. 1. the running forward of soldiers with emulation, जवादहंपुर्विका यियासुभिः Kir.xiv.82; 2. vaunting.
अहम्-पूर्विका, -प्रथमिका f. 1. the running forward of soldiers with emulation, जवादहंपुर्विका यियासुभिः Kir.xiv.82; 2. vaunting.
अहम्-भद्र n. self-conceit, a high notion of one’s superiority.
अहम्-भाव m. 1. self love considered as ignorance (in Vedānta phil.); 2. self-conceit, egotism.
अहम्-मति f. the same as अहंभाव q.v.
अहम्-मान m. the same as अहंभाव q.v.
अहल्य a. (f. ल्या) Unploughed.
अहल्य a. (f. ल्या) Unploughed.
अहल्या f. A Name of the wife of Gautama. (See App. II.)
अहल्या-जार m. an epithet of Indra.
अहल्या-नंदन m. Śatānanda, son of Ahalyā.
अहह ind. A particle implying- (1) sorrow or regret, e.g. अहह कष्टमपंडितता विधे Bhartr.ii.92, Sant.S.i.6; (2) wonder, अहह महता निःसीमानश्चरित्रविभूतय Bhartr.ii.35; (3) fatigue; (4) joy; (5) calling.
अहहा ind. The same as अहह q.v.
अहार्य (I) a. (f. र्या) 1. Not to be stolen or taken away, M.ix.189; 2. not to be shaken, K.S.v.8.
अहार्य (II) m. A mountain.
अहार्य (I) a. (f. र्या) 1. Not to be stolen or taken away, M.ix.189; 2. not to be shaken, K.S.v.8.

आहार्य (I) a. (f. र्या) 1. To be taken or seized; 2. artificial, adventitious, e.g. आहार्यशोभारहितैरमायैः (also see Mall. on K.S.vii.21); 3. of which the speaker is aware (as the identification (आरोप) in such figures of speech as रूपक, अतिशयोक्ति &c.; in ससन्देह or भ्रान्तिमान्, on the other hand, the identification is not आहार्य generally); 4. accomplished or effected by decoration or ornamentation. (See under अभिनय.)

आहार्य (I) a. (f. र्या) 1. To be taken or seized; 2. artificial, adventitious, e.g. आहार्यशोभारहितैरमायैः (also see Mall. on K.S.vii.21); 3. of which the speaker is aware (as the identification (आरोप) in such figures of speech as रूपक, अतिशयोक्ति &c.; in ससन्देह or भ्रान्तिमान्, on the other hand, the identification is not आहार्य generally); 4. accomplished or effected by decoration or ornamentation. (See under अभिनय.)
आहत-लक्षण a. noted for good qualities. Cf. आहितलक्षण.
आहति f. 1. A blow, a hit; 2. killing; 3. multiplication (in math.).
आहनन n. The same as आहति q.v.
आहर a. (f. रा) 1. Taking, seizing, R.i.49; 2. accomplishing.
आहर a. (f. रा) 1. Taking, seizing, R.i.49; 2. accomplishing.
आहार m. 1. Taking, bringing; 2. taking food; 3. food, M.xi.77.

आहरण n. 1. Removing from one place to another, bringing, समिदाहरणाय प्रस्थिता वयम् Sak.i.; 2. performing, accomplishing (as a sacrifice); 3. a dowry given to a bride at the time of her marriage, सत्वानुरूपाहरणीकृतश्रीः R.vii.32.
आहव m. 1. Sacrifice, तत्र नाभवदसौ महाहवे Sis.xiv.44; 2. battle, war, एवं विधेनाहवचेष्टितेन R.vii.67, Bg.i.13.
आहाव m. 1. A trough near a well for watering cattle; 2. war, battle; 3. calling, invoking.
आहव-काम्या f. desire of fight.
आहवन n. A sacrifice, द्रष्टुमाहवनमग्रजन्मनाम् Sis.xiv.38.
आहवनीय (I) a. (f. या) To be offered as an oblation.
आहवनीय (II) m. One of the three sacred fires (taken from the householder’s perpetual fire). See अग्नित्रेता.
आहवनीय (I) a. (f. या) To be offered as an oblation.
आहार-विरह m. want of food.
आहार-सम्भव m. the juice of the body.
